name: Ω Control Plane
purpose: Canonical contract for platform operations that span identity, notifications, privacy, search, analytics, media, onboarding, administration, payments and provider health.
truthPolicy: A contract is not provider availability. External capabilities remain UNVERIFIED until their provider, authorization, failure path and production evidence are verified.
providerEvidenceGate: secret configuration verified without exposing secrets
hardRules: Never expose provider secrets to the browser.
Never grant entitlements from a client-only success callback.
Never claim delivery when a provider has not confirmed delivery.
Never export data outside the authenticated user's authorization boundary.
Never delete authoritative records without an approved retention/deletion policy.
Never present operational KPIs as LIVE unless their source and freshness are known.
